data.explanation: This is the regular payment request for the German broadcasting fee for your home. The fee is €18.36 per month, paid for three months at a time. Transfer €55.08 to the account printed in the letter by 15 November 2026, using only the contribution number as the reference. You can set up a SEPA direct debit to avoid missing payments. If you receive certain benefits such as BAföG, you can apply for an exemption. The letter's IBAN is a German one and matches the bank details at the bottom, which looks consistent.
